apply.title: Configuration change plan
apply.subtitle: Generate and review a saved dry-run change plan before any write.
apply.placeholderBody: Full dry-run generation, confirmation, and execution controls are handled by the configuration change plan view.
apply.blockReasonSourceParse: Source failed to parse and cannot be materialized safely
apply.blockReasonTargetParse: Target failed to parse and cannot be materialized safely
apply.blockReasonEditedParse: The edited content failed to parse
apply.blockReasonBlankContent: Empty content: Nacos rejects blank bodies. Deselect this item or delete the target config instead
apply.confirmNormal: I reviewed this dry-run plan and understand it will write to the target.
apply.blockConfirmText: Type the required confirmation text above.
apply.blockConfirmMismatch: Confirmation text doesn't match the text above character for character. Check the capitalization and retype it.
apply.blockHasBlocked: Some selected items are blocked; uncheck them to run the rest.
apply.blockRunning: A task is already running; wait for it to finish.
apply.blockSucceeded: This plan already ran successfully; generate a new plan to run again.
apply.protectedInstruction: Type the following text to enable execution:
apply.executionSucceededWithBlocked: Change executed. Applied items: {count}; {blocked} blocked and skipped
apply.postWriteVerificationHeadline: Read-back: {confirmed}/{total} items match what was written
apply.postWriteVerificationHintConfirmed: Every item was compared against the live value. You can mark the sandbox verified here and prepare a promotion.
apply.postWriteVerificationHintWarning: Check the live values of these items first, then decide to mark verified, retry or roll back. Do not promote unconfirmed items.
apply.noSelectedItems: Select at least one change item.
apply.editTargetHint: Manually adjust the content that will be written to the target (use when auto-detection is inaccurate or you need to add something). Saving re-validates and updates this diff preview and the execution plan.
apply.manualTunedHint: The content written for this item was manually intervened (hand-tuned in step 3 or edited in step 4); it is not copied verbatim from the source
apply.discardEditsMessage: {count} item(s) still have unsaved target content. Going back discards it.
apply.leaveDuringRunMessage: A write task is running. Leaving this page hides its result here (progress stays visible in the task center); closing the app aborts in-flight requests and already-written configs are not rolled back automatically. Leave anyway?
apply.dryRunPreviewNote: Preview of what the target will look like after execution — nothing has been written yet. It is only applied when you execute the change in step 5.
apply.readBeforeSnapshotFailed: Failed to read the before-change snapshot for {ref}: {detail}
apply.publishRefBindingMissing: Publishing configuration by reference is not available in this build. Regenerate the ApplyPlan.
apply.deleteRefBindingMissing: Deleting configuration by reference is not available in this build. Regenerate the ApplyPlan.
apply.consulModifyIndexRequired: Consul target ModifyIndex is required for {dataId}. Regenerate the ApplyPlan.
apply.followupMissingPlanId: Apply record {id} is not linked to a change plan.
apply.followupMissingBackupSnapshot: Apply record {id} has no backup snapshot.
apply.followupSnapshotMissingPath: Backup snapshot {id} is missing its file path.
apply.followupVerificationDrift: Sandbox configuration drifted after verification. Items: {items}
apply.followupNoVerification: Apply record {id} has no sandbox verification.
apply.followupVerificationMismatch: Sandbox verification {verificationId} does not match apply record {id}.
apply.followupSameConnection: Promotion source and target cannot be the same connection.
apply.followupVerifySandboxFailed: Failed to verify sandbox current state: {detail}
apply.followupNoBackedUpItems: No configurations from this run are covered by backup snapshot {id}; a safe rollback plan cannot be built.
apply.draftSnapshotMissingPath: Snapshot source {id} is missing its file path.
apply.draftSnapshotMissingSourceConnection: Snapshot source {id} references missing source connection {connectionId}.
apply.keyLevelWriteUnsupported: Cannot materialize key-level apply for {ref} with format {format}.
apply.planStale: Change plan is stale. Regenerate the plan. Stale items: {items}
apply.writeConflictDetected: The target changed at the last moment before writing. This item was skipped and nothing was overwritten: {ref}
apply.progressPartial: {completed} of {total} items written; item {failedIndex} failed: {ref}. Earlier writes are already live on the target and can be rolled back with this run's backup snapshot from the operation history.
apply.progressNothingWritten: No item reached the target, so there is nothing to roll back: item {failedIndex} failed: {ref}.
apply.alreadyAppliedNote: {count} item(s) were already at this version on the target and were not written again.
apply.alreadyAppliedOnly: Nothing to write: the target is already at this version. No config was written and nothing was recorded in operation history.
apply.skipFailedItem: Skip this item, continue with the rest
apply.skipFailedItemHint: Runs the remaining {count} item(s) without the failed one; items already written are not written again.
apply.openHistoryToRollback: Roll back this run from operation history
apply.openHistoryToRollbackHint: This run is already in the operation history; rollback uses its pre-write backup snapshot.
apply.promotePanelIntro: These changes landed on the sandbox. To push them to production, mark the sandbox verified first, then pick a target and generate a new change plan.
apply.promoteReadbackConfirmed: All items match the written value
apply.promoteBlockedByUnconfirmed: {count} items are still unconfirmed in the read-back. Check the live values before verifying.
apply.promoteTargetNoProductionMarker: {target} has no production marker. Check that this is the environment you mean before promoting.
apply.promoteNamespaceLoadFailed: Couldn't list namespaces on {target}. Promotion will keep the sandbox namespace — verify the target location in the plan before anything is written.
apply.promoteNamespaceMissing: {namespace} isn't an existing namespace on {target}: promoting would create it rather than overwrite the config there. Pick one of this cluster's namespaces above if that's not what you want.
apply.promoteNoTarget: No writable production target (local snapshots and read-only connections can't be one). Add a writable environment in Connection management first.
apply.promoteRequiresVerification: Mark the sandbox verified before promoting.
apply.promoteDryRunPromise: Nothing is written here: promotion only produces a new change plan, which still needs selected changes and a passing dry-run before anything is written.

settings.networkDescription: Proxy settings used by app services such as update checks.
settings.compareDescription: Defaults that make repeated compare workflows easier to scan.
settings.credentialsDescription: Move local small credentials into the system credential store.
settings.backupDescription: Export, upload, preview, and restore ConfScope application data for device migration.
settings.dataLocationsDescription: Where ConfScope stores data and caches on this machine. Copy the path or open the location in the file manager. In portable mode these locations move with the data root.
settings.dataLocAppDataFile: Main data file (connections, plans, history, and all local data)
settings.dataLocationsUnavailable: Data locations are not available in this environment.
settings.revisionHistoryHint: Every version this app has read back or confirmed writing is stored on this computer. Apollo, Consul, and local snapshots rely on it for history. Only a local file is written; server-side history in the config center is untouched.
settings.revisionFactsKeep: Up to {count} versions kept per config
settings.revisionKeepHint: How many recent versions of each config to keep locally (valid range {min}–{max}). The earliest version of every key and all pinned versions don't count against it and are never pruned.
settings.revisionKeepSourceMissing: Not set yet, using the default of {count}
settings.revisionKeepSourceOutOfRange: The value was out of range and fell back to the default
settings.revisionKeepSourceUnreadable: Policy file unreadable, using the default
settings.revisionKeepSaved: Keep count saved — each config now keeps up to {count} versions
settings.confirmPruneRevisions: Unpinned versions over the current limit are deleted now; the earliest version of every key and all pinned versions are kept. Server-side history is untouched.
settings.revisionPruneNone: Nothing exceeds the limit — nothing to prune
settings.revisionFactsServerUntouched: Server-side history in the config center is untouched
settings.revisionFactsUnavailable: This build cannot show or clear the local revision history.
settings.confirmClearRevisions: Clear the local revision history? Config content often holds secrets. This record lives only on this computer and cannot be restored after deletion.
settings.clearRevisionsFailed: Failed to clear local revision history
settings.dataRootModePortable: Portable (data travels with the program folder)
settings.dataRootModeInstalled: Installed (data belongs to the current user)
settings.dataRootSourceUserChoice: Data location chosen in the app
settings.dataRootSourceLegacyAdoption: Reused an existing local data set
settings.dataRootMigrateMessage: Copies everything from the current location to the new one. Restart the app afterwards to make it take effect.
settings.dataRootMigrateKeepsSource: The old location is kept, so you can move back if anything looks wrong.
settings.dataRootMigrateRestartNote: One restart is required. Do not change the location again before restarting.
settings.dataRootMigrateReused: {count} files already match in the new location and will be skipped.
settings.dataRootRollbackTitle: Back to the Previous Data Location
settings.dataRootRollbackMessage: Only points the data root back to the previous location. Nothing is copied or deleted.
settings.dataRootRollbackRestartNote: One restart is required to switch back.
settings.dataRootRestartPending: Data location updated. Restart the app to apply it.
settings.dataRootPlanUnavailable: Could not read the migration plan. Try again.
settings.updateDescription: How often updates are checked and which version you skipped. Once a version is skipped, the About page stops mentioning it until you restore reminders here.
settings.updateSkipHint: Written by "Skip this version" on the About page. Clearing it here does not change the installed version.
settings.checkUpdatesInAboutHint: Checking, downloading, verifying and installing updates all happen on the About page, where you can follow every version diff and handoff step. A proxy change needs no restart — the next check uses it.
settings.updateReminderRestored: Reminders restored. The next check will mention that version again.
settings.developerDescription: Developer diagnostics: clear local cache (app cache + audit trail). Not needed by regular users.
settings.clearCacheHint: Removes local app cache (cs.*) and the audit trail (audit-trail.jsonl) to reset the scene after troubleshooting.
settings.confirmClearCache: Clear cache? This removes local app cache (cs.*) and the audit trail file. Connected Nacos server data is not affected.
settings.sshProfileNamePlaceholder: e.g. Company Bastion / Production Jump Host
settings.sshProfileRequired: Profile name, SSH server address, and username are required
settings.sshProfileDeleteBlocked: This SSH profile is referenced by {count} connections and cannot be deleted directly.
settings.sshProfileUpdateImpact: This SSH profile is referenced by {count} connections. Saving will make those connections use the new config immediately. Review the impact list and save again to confirm.
settings.compareSortConnectionsHint: When on, both connection dropdowns in the compare view are sorted by name; when off they keep the order from Connection Manager. This changes dropdown display order only, never the connections themselves.
settings.compareSortNamespacesHint: When on, namespace dropdowns are sorted by name; when off the order returned by the server is kept. With many connections and namespaces, keeping the original order makes it easier to find the one you just saw elsewhere.
settings.noProxyPatternHint: Separate no-proxy entries with commas: a hostname (localhost), a suffix starting with a dot (.internal covers every subdomain), CIDR (10.0.0.0/8) or *. Entries containing spaces or an http:// prefix never match.
settings.proxyOnlyForUpdate: The proxy covers update checks and downloads only. The next check already uses whatever you just typed — no restart needed. Nacos, Apollo, Consul and SSH connections never go through it.
settings.proxyErrorUrl: Enter the proxy server URL including the scheme, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890. Only http / https proxies are supported here — SOCKS is not.
settings.proxyErrorNoProxyItem: {item} is not a valid no-proxy entry. Use a hostname, a suffix starting with a dot, CIDR or * — no spaces, no http:// prefix.
settings.clearHistoryHint: Clear all local operation records. This action cannot be undone.
settings.dataFileDescription: Single source of truth for app data (connections, settings, plans, history, etc.). Browser storage is only a hot cache; it falls back automatically when the file is corrupt or the cache is lost.
settings.dataFileNone: Not created yet (auto-created on first data change)

connection.title: Connection Manager
connection.pageSubtitle: Organize config-center access by project, environment, and source. Source describes the target network or backup shape; SSH tunnel is configured separately as an access mode.
connection.copyReady: Copied as a new connection draft. Edit and save to create it.
connection.name: Remark (optional)
connection.namePlaceholder: e.g. Company VPN only / Travel fallback / Read-only account
connection.nameHelp: Remark explains when to use this source config. It is not the sidebar title. The sidebar title uses Source Name; empty remark uses the source name internally.
connection.projectHelp: Project is the business-system level. Pick an existing project or type a new one.
connection.environmentHelp: Environment is a fixed runtime category under a project. Existing historical values stay in the dropdown so old connections keep their grouping.
connection.sourceNamePlaceholder: e.g. Cloud Public / Cloud Intranet / Company Intranet
connection.sourceNameHelp: One project environment can have multiple sources, such as cloud public, cloud intranet, company intranet, or travel network. SSH is an access mode, not a source category.
connection.useProxyHelp: When enabled, Nacos HTTP requests will go through the proxy configured in SettingsView. Disabled for direct connection.
connection.proxyOffHint: Direct connection mode, proxy disabled. Configure proxy in global settings.
connection.providerHelp: Select the config center type. Apollo and Consul currently support read-only browse, compare, and audit.
connection.apolloTokenHelp: Apollo OpenAPI authorization token, sent as the Authorization request header.
connection.apolloEnvHelp: Apollo OpenAPI env parameter, such as DEV, FAT, UAT, or PRO.
connection.apolloAppIdHelp: Apollo application ID. It is also used as the default namespace in browse and compare views.
connection.apolloNamespaceNameHelp: Apollo namespaceName, such as application or datasource.json.
connection.consulTokenHelp: Consul HTTP API token. Optional; when set it is sent as the X-Consul-Token request header.
connection.consulDatacenterHelp: Consul datacenter, such as dc1. Empty uses the server default.
connection.consulKeyPrefixHelp: KV prefix to browse, such as apps/order/. Empty attempts to browse all KV.
connection.sourcePresetHelp: Source entry describes which network or entry the target Nacos belongs to, such as cloud public, cloud intranet, or company intranet. Choose SSH tunnel separately in access mode.
connection.sourceTypeHelp: Online connection accesses Nacos directly. Local snapshot directory reads exported backup configs for comparison.
connection.localPathPlaceholder: Enter or choose a local folder path
connection.localPathHelp: Choose the exported config snapshot directory. Windows can use folder picker or type a path directly; Linux/macOS can type the path. The directory is validated after choosing.
connection.localPathStructureHint: Directory must contain confscope.snapshot.json / manifest.json / metadata.json / .metadata.yml, or configs/ / namespaces/ standard folders, and at least 1 comparable config file. When metadata exists at root, sibling folders are treated as groups and file relative paths become dataIds.
connection.forceLocalSnapshotHelp: Allow saving even when directory validation fails. Reading or comparison may fail later; use only when you know the directory is usable.
connection.localValidationRequired: Validate the local snapshot directory before saving
connection.localValidationOk: Directory is valid, found {count} config files
connection.localValidationMissingStructure: Snapshot manifest or standard directory structure was not found
connection.localValidationMissingConfigs: No comparable config files were found
connection.localValidationInvalidMetadata: metadata.json is not valid snapshot metadata
connection.localValidationMissingSchemaFields: metadata.json is missing required snapshot schema fields
connection.localValidationLegacyOk: Directory uses a legacy snapshot layout. Regenerate the snapshot when possible.
connection.defaultSourceHelp: When an environment has multiple sources, the default source is preferred by browse and compare entry points.
connection.addressHelp: Use the real Nacos URL, for example http://host:8848/nacos. With SSH tunnel, still enter the Nacos URL the tunnel should reach.
connection.usernameHelp: Use this for open-source Nacos username/password auth. Leave empty for no-auth.
connection.authTypeHelp: Choose the authentication mode used by the Nacos server. Aliyun MSE usually uses AccessKey.
connection.distributionHelp: Open-source Nacos uses username/password or no-auth. Aliyun MSE switches to AccessKey credentials.
connection.accessModeHelp: Access mode only describes the technical path. Even a cloud public source may need SSH tunnel or jump-host access because of firewall policy.
connection.securityTokenPlaceholder: Use this for temporary STS credentials
connection.securityTokenHelp: Only needed for temporary STS credentials. Long-term AccessKey usually leaves this empty.
connection.passwordHelp: Locally saved Nacos password. Encrypted storage will be improved later.
connection.accessKeyHelp: Aliyun MSE Nacos access credential. Use an AccessKey with config read permissions.
connection.testConnectedNoAuth: No account configured. Connecting without authentication ({latency})
connection.traceConnectedAdmin: Connected successfully. Current account is an administrator.
connection.traceConnectedNoAuth: No account configured. Connecting without authentication.
connection.traceConnectionParamsDetail: Target config: {provider} / {baseUrl}. This only means local connection parameters were read; it does not mean the config center is reachable.
connection.traceSshProfileSelected: SSH profile selected. Later steps will verify the local tunnel entry and remote target.
connection.traceLocalTunnelForwardFailed: The request entered the local tunnel entry, but remote forwarding failed.
connection.traceLocalTunnelForwarded: The request passed through the local tunnel entry and continued forwarding.
connection.traceLocalTunnelUnknown: Local tunnel entry was not confirmed. Check SSH login, private key, port occupancy, and local forwarding creation.
connection.traceRemoteTargetForwardFailed:
The local port received the request, but the connection was closed or reset while forwarding to the remote target. Check the jump host in the SSH profile, Nacos intranet address, target port, and firewall policy.
Original error: {error}
connection.traceRemoteTargetSkipped: Local tunnel entry was not confirmed, so remote target connectivity cannot be determined.
connection.traceRemoteTargetConfirmed: Config center response received; remote target connectivity is confirmed.
connection.traceApiSkippedRemoteFailed: Remote target is not reachable, so the config center API itself cannot be determined.
connection.traceApiSkippedSshFailed: SSH session or local tunnel entry was not established, so the config center API itself cannot be determined.
connection.traceSuccessSshSummary: SSH entry, remote target, and config center API all passed.
connection.traceFailureTunnelSummary: The request entered the local tunnel entry, but the remote target is not reachable. Check the SSH profile, target intranet address, target port, and firewall first.
connection.traceFailureSshSummary: SSH session or local tunnel entry was not established. Check SSH login, private key, port occupancy, and local forwarding creation first.
connection.traceFailureSshApiSummary: The config center path was reached, but the API returned failure. Check auth, path, namespace, or MSE signature settings according to the API error.
connection.nameAndAddressRequired: Source name and target address are required
connection.apolloRequired: Apollo token, env, app ID, cluster, and namespace are required
connection.deleteNote: Local connection info will be removed, but won't affect the Nacos server.
connection.fieldsRequired: SSH address / port / username cannot be empty
connection.passwordRequired: Password auth: password cannot be empty
connection.keyRequired: Key auth: private key cannot be empty
connection.noConnections: No connections yet, create one on the right
connection.defaultNamespaceHelp: Nacos namespaceId. Empty means public; this is not the namespace display name.
connection.defaultGroupHelp: Nacos group. Empty or DEFAULT_GROUP means the default group; when set, browse/compare/create use it by default.
connection.sshProfileHelp: Choose a reusable SSH jump-host profile. When a profile is selected, the connection stores only the reference instead of duplicating SSH credentials.
connection.sshProfileRequired: SSH server address and username are required
connection.sshHostHelp: Jump host or bastion address, not the Nacos address.
connection.sshPortHelp: SSH port of the jump host, usually 22.
connection.sshUsernameHelp: System user used to log in to the jump host.
connection.sshAuthHelp: Authentication mode used to log in to the jump host.
connection.sshPasswordHelp: SSH password for the jump host.
connection.localPortHelp: Temporary local listening port. Leave empty for automatic assignment in most cases.
connection.privateKeyHelp: Private key used to log in to the jump host.
connection.privateKeyPasswordHelp: Fill this only when the private key has a passphrase.

diff.title: Smart Config Compare
diff.selectHint: Select configs on both sides and click "Compare"
diff.resultStale: The latest change plan modified configs on either side, so the comparison below may be out of date.
diff.noMatchedDataId: No dataId found under the selected namespaces and groups
diff.noConnection: Please add Nacos connections in "Connection Manager" first
diff.selectSameNameOnly: Only compare files present on both sides
diff.pageSubtitle: Deep compare differences between two config sources
diff.sourceCollapsedHint: Collapsed. Expand to change connection, namespace, and dataId.
diff.supportHint:
This page finds differences between two config sources. Supports: Same Nacos two configs · Cross-namespace · Cross-environment comparison
Leave dataId empty to auto-match and show left-only / right-only configs
diff.nextStepHint: Confirm the left source → right target direction, then click Load & Compare. To use a sandbox, choose it on the right; enter the configuration change plan after reviewing the differences.
diff.workflowStep1Detail: The apply direction is fixed as left source → right target. The right side can be a sandbox when you want a safer trial path.
diff.workflowStep2Detail: Click Load & Compare, then review single-config, batch-file, line, or key differences.
diff.workflowStep3Detail: Select rows or blocks to bring from the left source into the right target, then enter the configuration change plan.
diff.workflowStep4Detail: The system loads the latest content to build a dry-run plan; the right-side target is NOT modified at this point. The "After" column previews what the right side will look like after execution. Only step 5 (Execute) actually writes to the right side. Select the files to execute, then confirm and run.
diff.workflowStep5Detail: In this step, read the post-write check, mark the sandbox verified, then pick a production target to build a new plan.
diff.batchSelectHint: Select a file on the left to review its diff.
diff.contentSearchAriaLabel: Search these comparison results by config content
diff.contentSearchCapped: Showing the first {max} matched configs ({scope} in scope; the rest unscanned)

diff.manualTuneHint: Hand-write what "{label}" should finally receive: use this where picking blocks is not enough (intranet addresses, secrets, namespaces, switch defaults). Saving carries this text into the change plan.

diff.manualTuneBlank: Content cannot be empty: a blank body would write an empty config to the target.
diff.manualTuneMarksCleared: Right side updated by hand, and the previous row-level picks were cleared - after a manual edit those line numbers no longer point at what you picked.

diff.logRecorded: Compare session recorded (session id visible in Audit Log)

history.title: History
history.rollbackNote: This will overwrite and publish to Nacos
history.pickHint: Pick 1 to compare with online · Pick 2 to compare each other
history.centerHistoryUnsupported: This config center has no namespace-wide history list: select the config in Browse and use its History tab.
history.selectHint: Click a version on the left to view, or pick versions to compare
history.localListHint: What this machine has seen, not release times from the config center
history.localEmpty: No local revision yet. One is recorded when content is read; use Reload to check again
history.localPinTitle: Pin this content: pruning never deletes it (the pin follows the content hash, covering every row with the same content)
history.localPinNoRow: This exact content is no longer recorded locally (it may have just been pruned) — nothing was pinned
history.localObservedTimeTitle: When this machine first saw this revision (not the config center's release time)
history.localWrittenTimeTitle: When ConfScope wrote this revision and read it back to confirm
history.localFirstSeenTitle: When this machine first saw the revision; a confirmed write moves the timestamp but keeps this
history.localVsPrev: Changes against the previous local record {label}
history.localFirst: Oldest local record (earlier revisions were pruned)
history.localContentOmittedNote: This revision's body ({size}) exceeded the per-record limit, so only its digest and size were kept
history.localLoadFailed: Failed to read local revision history
history.localPlanFailed: Failed to build a rollback plan from the local revision
history.sourceHint: Each history keeps its own source; they are never merged into one column
history.localPinHint: Pinning protects one version by its content digest: pruning and quota cleanup never remove it, and rows holding the same text are kept together.

audit.selectHint: Select a project, configure environment sources, then click "Run Audit" to generate the matrix.
audit.normalizeEnabledLabel: Enable name normalization (align dataIds across environments)
audit.logRecorded: Audit run recorded: {id} (viewable in Audit Log)

operationHistory.focusRecordMissing: Cannot locate record {id}; the local operation history may have been cleared.
operationHistory.confirmClear: Are you sure to clear all local operation records?
operationHistory.planSummaryText: Total {total} · Create {create} · Overwrite {overwrite} · Delete {delete} · Skip {skip} · Blocked {blocked}
operationHistory.changeDetailEmpty: Nothing to compare for this run.
operationHistory.changeDetailNoChangedItems: These configs are identical before and after.
operationHistory.changeDetailScopeUnverified: This record has no stored execution scope; the list below covers every executable plan item.
operationHistory.changeDetailPartialScope: This run failed halfway: only {count} item(s) were actually written. The list below covers those only.
operationHistory.changeDetailContentMissing: Its content was not archived with the plan, so no diff is available.
operationHistory.changeDetailNoPlan: No change plan attached; only the content below is available.
operationHistory.changeDetailPlanExpired: The local copy of that change plan is gone (only the latest 100 are kept), so this run's diff cannot be reconstructed.
operationHistory.emptyHint: Publish, delete, and rollback operations will appear here.
operationHistory.rollbackPlanExpired: This machine no longer keeps a snapshot of that change plan (only the latest 100 are stored), so rollback from the backup snapshot is unavailable.
operationHistory.rollbackNoPlanOnRecord: This record is not linked to a change plan, so there is no recorded state to roll back to.
operationHistory.rollbackMissingBackupSnapshot: This record has no pre-write backup snapshot, so there is no recorded state to roll back to.
operationHistory.rollbackNothingWritten: Nothing was written in this run, so there is no state to roll back.
operationHistory.rollbackTargetConnectionMissing: The target connection of this record is no longer in the connection list, so a rollback plan cannot be built.
operationHistory.rollbackTargetNotWritable: The target of this record is a non-writable source (local snapshot or read-only connection); rollback only goes through a change plan, so no entry is offered.
operationHistory.rollbackFromRecordedContent: Build a rollback plan from the recorded previous content
operationHistory.rollbackOnlySuccess: Only successful operations can be rolled back
operationHistory.rollbackUnsupportedType: This operation type cannot be rolled back
operationHistory.rollbackMissingContent: Missing previous content, cannot roll back
operationHistory.rollbackDisabled: This operation is marked as not rollbackable
operationHistory.rollbackExportOnly: Export only generates a local file and cannot be rolled back
operationHistory.rollbackSnapshotOnly: Snapshot operations only create or delete local backups and cannot be rolled back
operationHistory.rollbackRequiresApplyPlan: Rollback requires a change-plan dry-run and cannot publish previous content directly.
operationHistory.rollbackApplyRequiresPlan: Change-plan records require a rollback dry-run and cannot be rolled back directly
operationHistory.rollbackFromBackupPlan: Roll back written items from the backup snapshot
operationHistory.partialFailureFollowupHint: This run did not finish: written items are still live on the target. Roll them back with the backup snapshot, then regenerate the plan.
operationHistory.promoteEntryLocation: Promotion lives in step 5 of the change plan: after the sandbox run, verify it there, pick a production target, and a new plan is generated.
operationHistory.selectHintDetail: View config, source, result, and error details.
